FOUND 3
- `src/main.js:81`: `draw(ctx, state, hover)` still doesn't pass `kind`, so the HUD never shows the selected kind. This is the P0 from the last gate, and it is still open. Commit c874a0d made this exact fix, and 5e7f6dd took it back out. The reason: `test/pause-speed.test.js` (`hudAt`, around lines 157–204) checks the HUD's exact list of text strings, so adding the kind label turns 3 of its tests red. That test file is not in the signed touches, and editing it, dodging its check or amending touches are all outside this stage. Left for fail-forward to widen touches by adding `test/pause-speed.test.js`. Then `main.js` passes `kind` after `SPRITES`, and `hudAt` adds `` `${LANTERN.name} (${LANTERN.cost})` `` at the end of its list.
- `src/render.js:37`: nothing tested that `draw` shows the kind's label when given a kind. Added a test to `test/frost.test.js`, and it fails when the label line is removed. Fixed (341fa12).
- `src/render.js:337,379`: the HUD font `'16px system-ui, sans-serif'` was written out twice. It is now one constant, `HUD_FONT`. Fixed (2d2bbd3).

GATES red: the last gate finding (P0, `main.js` doesn't pass the kind to `draw`) is still open because the signed touches can't hold the fix. `npm --prefix . run test` passes 123/123. This repo has no Makefile, so I ran the checks with `node --test` on the touched test files.
